name: single-cell-transcriptome-proteome-integration-workflow
description: Use when paired single-cell transcriptome and protein count matrices with reference cell labels need a joint embedding, a clustering resolution sweep, and a report of agreement with the supplied labels.

name: spatial-transcriptomics-niche-analysis-workflow
description: Use when image-based spatial transcriptomics includes transcript coordinates, staining channels and an aligned histology image, and needs resolved cell boundaries, per-cell measurements and image-derived spatial niches.
